senses.gloss: m. (corr. נֵיס—εὐγενής) of noble descent. Koh. R. beg.; a. fr. (Midr. Till. to Ps. I אביינוס; Cant. R. beg. אווגיטוס, corr. acc.).—Pl.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 863:8">Yalk. Ps. 863</cite> <he>שהוא אֶוְגְּנֵסִין</he> (read <he>בן א׳</he>) he is the son of nobles; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 105:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. CV</cite> <he>בן גנסין</he> (corr. acc.) cmp. <he>גְּנִיס</he>.
